ruleDefinitions.name: ISO Image Mounted
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the mount of an ISO image on an endpoint Note: Unmapped fields: ObjectServer, ObjectType, ObjectName

sequences.query: (event_id = 4663 AND ObjectServer = "Security" AND ObjectType = "File" AND ObjectName = RGX("^\\\\Device\\\\CdRom")) AND  NOT ((ObjectName = "\\Device\\CdRom0\\autorun\.ico" OR ObjectName = "\\Device\\CdRom0\\setup\.exe" OR ObjectName = "\\Device\\CdRom0\\setup64\.exe"))
